terminals.name: server
terminals.command: cd server && MONGO_URI=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/reqspace-web NODE_ENV=production PORT=3005 COOKIE_SECURE=false node dist/index.js
terminals.description: Reqspace web server (API + built client) on http://localhost:3005, backed by local MongoDB. Rebuild with `npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server` after code changes, then restart this terminal.
